provenance_note: Interval facts independently encoded from cited references; no source MIDI, scores, prose, audio or Scala archive copied. Genre/tradition tags are non-exclusive discovery hints, not style guarantees. Traditional entries are explicitly 12-TET approximations. Synthetic 24-EDO is a mathematical test, not an Arabic maqam.

scales.name: 長音階 / Major (12-TET)
scales.approximation: Exact definition in twelve-tone equal temperament; not a claim about all performance intonation.

scales.name: 自然短音階 / Natural minor (12-TET)
scales.approximation: Natural minor only; no automatic harmonic/melodic-minor alteration or direction-dependent behavior.

scales.name: ヨナ抜き長音階 / Major pentatonic (12-TET)
scales.approximation: Five-note 12-TET pitch set. Shared intervals do not identify an exclusive region, genre or melodic practice.

scales.name: 琉球音階（十二平均律近似） / Ryukyu pitch-set approximation
scales.approximation: 12-TET approximation of the common C-E-F-G-B reference. Does not encode traditional tuning, variants or melodic behavior; not all Ryukyuan music uses this set.

scales.name: 都音階（十二平均律近似） / Miyako pitch-set approximation
scales.approximation: 12-TET approximation of the C-Db-F-G-Ab reference. Traditional tuning and performance grammar are outside this pitch-set definition.

scales.name: 24等分音階・動作確認 / 24-EDO mathematical test
scales.approximation: Original equal division 1200*n/24 cents, n=0..23. A diagnostic grid, not an authentic Arabic, Turkish or other traditional scale.
